paragraph: The US is trying to **dominate** the world. Don't let that man **dominate** you. He likes to **dominate** every conversation.
english: to govern, rule or control by superior authority or power

paragraph: There is an important **alliance** between these two countries. He argued for our forming the **alliance** with that nation. Many countries have joined the defensive **alliance**.
english: the state of being allied
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حلف

other.meaning: state of being allied

paragraph: For once, **Sue** came to the meeting on time. **Sue** has a big bottom, but she doesn't care. The girl standing over there is my sister **Sue**.
english: to file a legal action
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أقام دعوى

paragraph: Haven't there been a lot of **awful** accidents recently? That looks like an **awful** lot for two people. Why are you so sad? Today wasn't that **awful**.
english: very bad
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أربد

paragraph: I will say this only once, so listen **carefully**. Think **carefully** about what you are going to do. We have very little time, so listen **carefully**.
english: in a careful manner
arabicDesc: مثال: سأقوله مرّة واحدة فقط، إذن تسمع بعناية

paragraph: You can probably buy one of these cheaper **elsewhere**. The boss is never late, he is delayed **elsewhere**. His talents could be put to better use **elsewhere**.
english: in or to another place

paragraph: They went on the **offensive** in the first half. That joke is **offensive** on so many levels. The demand contained nothing that could be viewed as **offensive**.
english: an attack
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: حملة، هجمة

paragraph: Living in **poverty** was no walk in the park. In recent years, **poverty** has increased in the country. He passed the test in the face of **poverty**.
english: the quality or state of being poor

paragraph: The dialogue in this movie is **ridiculous**. I'm leaving. How can you give your children such **ridiculous** names? It would be **ridiculous** to do that by yourself.
english: foolish, absurd
arabicDesc: مثال: الحوار في هذا الفيلم سخيف. سأغادر.

paragraph: You are too **sensitive** to noise. An artist has to have a color-**sensitive** eye. My wisdom tooth is very **sensitive** to hot foods.
english: responsive to stimuli
arabicDesc: مثال: أنت حساس جدا للضجيج.

other.meaning: having the faculty of sensation; pertaining to the senses

paragraph: We're facing a **violent** crisis. Recent comics have too many **violent** and sexual scenes. To tell the truth, I'm tired of **violent** movies.
english: involving physical conflict
arabicDesc: مثال: نحن بصدد كارثة عنيفة.

paragraph: Hey, the new **recruit** this time seems really cute. The captain exercised the new **recruits** with long marches. We should make use of that for **recruiting**.
english: to get new people to join a company or group

paragraph: A further **reduction** would make us go into the red. He was clearly angling for a **reduction** on his rent. We protested against the **reduction** in wages.
english: the act, process, or result of reducing

paragraph: The **crop** was poor due to lack of water. The rice **crop** was poor, owing to the floods. You never know when a problem might **crop** up.
english: natural production for a specific year

other.meaning: part of bird's or other animal's alimentary tract

paragraph: Divide this line **segment** into twenty equal parts. This **segment** is brought to you by the Ford Motor Company. Many firms are competing for the wealthier **segment** of the market.
english: one part of something

paragraph: They cleaned the **trash** against the clinic wall. There is so much **trash** here. You haven't taken out the **trash** yet, have you?
english: things to be discarded
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد نظّفوا القمامة التي كانت عند جدار العيادة.

other.meaning: container

paragraph: I was a second **lieutenant** in the special forces. The **lieutenant** ordered all the civilians to get off the train. I got along with the **lieutenant** colonel.
english: the lowest junior commissioned officer rank(s) in many military forces, often Army and Marines

paragraph: It may **freeze** next week. Mars is a **frozen** world. The entire world was **frozen**.
english: to become solid due to low temperature
arabicDesc: مثال: من الممكن أن تتجمد الأسبوع القادم.

paragraph: I didn't mean to **imply** you were at fault. I'm not trying to **imply** anything of the kind. I didn't mean to **imply** that that wasn't fair.
english: to have as a necessary consequence

paragraph: She's good at creating the **narrative** of a crime. The media loves a **narrative** more than documenting facts. They believe that the **narrative** isn't in their favor.
english: telling a story

other.meaning: The systematic recitation of an event or series of events (noun)

paragraph: That kind of behavior is **characteristic** of the boy. Such a custom is **characteristic** of the British. It is **characteristic** of him to do such a thing.
english: a distinguishing feature of a person or thing, a part of mental or physical behavior

paragraph: We knew that the **sail** had holes in it. The leaves **sail** to the ground one after the other. This ship will **sail** for England around evening.
english: the concept of a sail or sails, as if a substance

other.meaning: To be impelled or driven forward by the action of wind upon sails, as a ship on water (verb)

paragraph: The **frequency** of crime in the town is high. I'm concerned about the **frequency** of his actions. I'm looking for a list of high-**frequency** French words.
english: the rate of occurrence of anything

paragraph: How do you know if your email account has been **hacked**? I spent the first few weeks learning how to **hack**. I've been trying to **hack** my way into the system.
english: to gain illegal access to a computer network
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف تعلم إن كان حساب بريدك الإلكتروني قد اختُرق؟

other.meaning: A tool for chopping (noun)

paragraph: There are a lot of students in the **gym**. The **gym** teacher told me to speed up. This is a clinic, not a **gym**.
english: a sports facility specialized for lifting weights, cardio machines, and other exercise (culturally differentiated from sense 1)
arabicDesc: مثال: هناك الكثير من الطلبة في القاعة الرياضية.

paragraph: The fight began with the **rapid** exchange of blows. I hope that I will receive a **rapid** response. Computer science has made **rapid** progress in our country.
english: very swift or quick

paragraph: Even the birds are staying in the **shade** here! They sat in the **shade** of a tree. Let's sit where there is some **shade**.
english: darkness where light is blocked
arabicDesc: مثال: حتى الطيور باقية هُنا في الظِل.

paragraph: He knows how to **fry** eggs. Do you want some **fries** with it? It's so hot outside, you could **fry** an egg.
english: to cook (something) in hot fat or oil
arabicDesc: مثال: هو يعرف كيف يقلي البيض.

paragraph: In German, **compound** words are written as one word! **Compound** interest is the most powerful force in the universe. A **compound** word consist of two smaller words.
english: composed of elements

paragraph: Heavy posts are needed to **sustain** this bridge. Can the island **sustain** itself without trade? Time and space are one body, mind and things **sustain** each other.
english: to maintain, or keep in existence

other.meaning: to provide for or nourish something

paragraph: The work is not worth the cost of **preparation**. He complained about not having enough time for **preparation**. Our failure was due to a lack of **preparation**.
english: the act of preparing or getting ready
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: إعداد، تجهيز، استعداد

paragraph: They **adapted** themselves to the change quickly. This book is **adapted** for children. It is hard to **adapt** this story for children.
english: to make suitable
arabicDesc: مثال: تأقلمن مع التغيير بسرعة.

paragraph: There are lots of **dust** balls under the bed. The car left a cloud of **dust** behind it. Each passing car threw up a cloud of **dust**.
english: fine particles
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تراب

paragraph: The bridge is about to **collapse**. They were mining when it **collapsed**. The house **collapsed** in an earthquake.
english: to fall down suddenly; to cave in
arabicDesc: مثال: يوشك الجسر على الانهيار.

other.meaning: The act of collapsing (noun)

paragraph: I made it so only root could access the **administrative** screen. Please forward the document to the **administrative** office for review. The city is divided into ten **administrative** districts.
english: relating to managing an organization
arabicDesc: مثال: هيئتُ النظام بحيث لا يستطيع إلا الجذر الوصول إلى الشاشة الإدارية.

paragraph: The two houses stand **alongside** of each other. Let's go on a walk **alongside** the beach after the meal. Houses were lined up **alongside** the highway.
english: side by side with

paragraph: Never again would she be **curious** about the city. She is **curious** to find who sent the flowers. She was so **curious** to know what that was.
english: tending to ask questions, or to want to explore or investigate

paragraph: I thought law **enforcement** would come to my rescue. I resorted to the help of law **enforcement**. The government will adopt **enforcement** measures to solve this problem.
english: making people obey a law or rule

paragraph: Do you know the **formal** version of this word? We should write a **formal** letter to the director. The US took **formal** possession of the islands in 1867.
english: in accordance with established forms
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: صوري

paragraph: I'm **hungry**, so I'm going to get something to eat. A **hungry** man is an angry man. The smell of food made me **hungry**.
english: affected by hunger; desirous of food
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا جائع، لذلك سأذهب لتناول بعض الطعام.

paragraph: **Photography** is now considered a new form of art. Flash **photography** is not permitted beyond this point. **Photography** allows me to capture moments of wonder.
english: the art and technology of producing images on photosensitive surfaces, and its digital counterpart
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: فوتوغرافيا

paragraph: He and he love her and her, **respectively**. The answers to those questions are yes and no, **respectively**. Who and who goes where and where, **respectively**?
english: in the same order as the things just mentioned

paragraph: I have been **silent** for a long time. Be **silent**, or speak something worth hearing. Why have things gone **silent** outside?
english: free from sound or noise; absolutely still; perfectly quiet
arabicDesc: مثال: لقد كنت صامتا لمدة طويلة

paragraph: The space crew **successfully** completed their mission to Mars. I hope you will **successfully** finish what you started. After **successfully** completing his studies, he began to work.
english: in a successful manner

paragraph: I heard an **unusual** noise. It's **unusual** for you to do something like that. Snowing at this time of the year is **unusual**.
english: not common
arabicDesc: مثال: سمعت ضجة غريبة.

paragraph: I can't believe I have to sit an **exam** on Sunday! If you are to succeed in the **exam**, you must study hard. Good luck on the **exam**!
english: a test of knowledge
arabicDesc: مثال: لا أصدق أن عليّ أخذ اختبار يوم الأحد!

paragraph: How did you come up with the idea for this **exhibition**? They awarded her first prize at the art **exhibition**. The roses on **exhibition** are grouped together by colors.
english: large scale public showing of objects or products
arabicDesc: مثال: كيف خطرت ببالك فكرة المعرض هذا؟

paragraph: Would you please **pour** me a cup of coffee? It began to **pour** again. I burnt my hand while **pouring** hot water.
english: to cause to flow in a stream
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لك أن تصبّ لي كأساً من القهوة من فضلك؟

paragraph: You were sent here to **spy** on us! You aren't a **spy**, are you? The **spy** burned the papers.
english: to act as a spy
arabicDesc: مثال: أرسلوك إلى هنا لتتجسس علينا!

paragraph: You leave me no alternative but **alert** the authorities. They stayed **alert** for the course of the class. My son needs to be more **alert** at school.
english: attentive

paragraph: The army **raided** the rebel camp. Our army staged a night **raid** against the enemy. The police did not dare to **raid**.
english: a quick hostile or predatory incursion or invasion in a battle
arabicDesc: مثال: شن الجيش هجوما على مخيم المتمردين.

other.meaning: attack for the purpose of making arrests, seizing property, or plundering
To engage in a raid against (verb)

paragraph: How much do you **weigh**? The responsibility **weighs** on me. I just wanted to **weigh** in with my opinion.
english: to determine the weight of an object
arabicDesc: مثال: ما وزنك؟

paragraph: Give me a **telephone** call when you get back. In case of fire, **telephone** the fire station. She always forgets my **telephone** number.
english: a means of communicating information from one person to another or others
arabicDesc: مثال: إتصل بي حين ترجع.

other.meaning: To convey (information, a message, news, etc.) using a telephone (noun sense 1) (verb)

paragraph: We were given the **privilege** of using the library. We were granted the **privilege** of fishing in this bay. He had the **privilege** of a private education.
english: a particular benefit, advantage, or favor

paragraph: What methods **yield** the best results in language learning? They obtained a **yield** of 8 percent on their investment. You must not **yield** to your desire to drink.
english: to give as a result or outcome
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: أجزى، أدر، أغل

other.meaning: A product (noun)

paragraph: Good morning, ladies and **gentlemen**! A true **gentleman** must not keep a lady waiting. The **gentleman** was standing in front of the bank.
english: well-bred, well-mannered, or charming man
arabicDesc: مثال: صباح الخير, أيها السيدات والسادة!

other.meaning: man of breeding
polite form of address to a man

paragraph: They couldn't do anything but stand there and **stare**. He continued to **stare** at me. They were both **staring** at me.
english: to look fixedly
arabicDesc: مثال: لم يكن بإمكانهم فعل شيء إلا الوقوف والمشاهدة.

paragraph: My **mum** has three dogs. I happened to see your **mum** at the library. When was the last time you saw your **mum**?
english: mother (informal, familiar)
arabicDesc: مثال: لدى أمي ثلاثة كلاب.

paragraph: That's one of the **ugliest** dogs I've ever seen. Those are the **ugliest** shoes I've ever seen. The teacher gave me the **ugliest** look.
english: displeasing to the eye
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: بشع

paragraph: The end **justifies** the means. I don't feel any need to **justify** this position. Authorities must **justify** their decisions as defined by law.
english: provide an acceptable explanation
arabicDesc: مثال: الغاية تبرر الوسيلة.

other.meaning: excuse something bad, warrant

paragraph: Plug the **drill** in and see if it still works. Make a hole in the bone with a **drill**. They rang the alarm to start a new **drill**.
english: to make a hole
arabicDesc: مثال: اربط المثقب بالمقبس و انظر إن كان لا يزال يشتغل.

other.meaning: A tool or machine used to remove material so as to create a hole, typically by plunging a rotating cutting bit into a stationary workpiece (noun)

paragraph: The **bullet** went through his body. He got a **bullet** wound in his left foot. The tree branch broke when a **bullet** hit it.
english: projectile
arabicDesc: مثال: إخترقت الرصاصة جسده.

paragraph: Do you know how much you **embarrass** me? I didn't want to **embarrass** you. We're not going to do anything to **embarrass** you.
english: to disrupt someone's composure or comfort with acting publicly or freely
arabicDesc: مثال: هل لديك فكرة عن مدى إحراجك لي؟

paragraph: I'm going to **suspend** my judgment until the movie is over. We reserve the right to **suspend** any account that violates our terms of use. Trains have been **suspended** owing to multiple fallen trees.
english: to halt something temporarily

paragraph: He was dancing on her **grave**. He is digging his own **grave** with his actions. That would make him roll over in his **grave**.
english: excavation for burial
arabicDesc: مثال: فرح كثيرا بوفاتها.

paragraph: The child was made a **ward** of the state. There doesn't seem to be any heating on the **ward**. They insulted the baby to **ward** off the evil eye.
english: protection, defence

paragraph: That church organization takes in **refugees**. The **refugees** took shelter in a Red Cross **refugee** camp. I was born in a **refugee** camp.
english: a person who has left their country to escape danger
arabicDesc: مثال: هذه المنظمة الكنيسية تستقبل اللاجئين.

paragraph: Any activity you need to **accomplish** will take more time than you have. He **accomplished** the work as planned. I'm proud of what I've been able to **accomplish**.
english: to finish successfully
arabicDesc: مثال: أي نشاط تحتاج لتحقيقه ستحتاج إلى وقت أكثر مما تملكه.

paragraph: I **brush** my teeth twice a day. I often forget to **brush** my teeth. I'm going to **brush** my teeth.
english: to clean (with a brush)
arabicDesc: مثال: أفرش أسناني مرتين في اليوم.

other.meaning: to untangle/arrange

paragraph: The channel has low signal-to-noise **ratio**. What's the student/teacher **ratio** at your school? The Golden **Ratio** is found everywhere in nature.
english: a number representing a comparison between two named things

paragraph: Please use a **tissue** instead of picking your nose. I would never use a previously used **tissue** again. Using a **tissue** shows good manners, unlike picking your nose.
english: thin, woven, gauzelike fabric

other.meaning: aggregation of cells

paragraph: It's not a bank. It's a **currency** exchange office. Attention is a **currency** that I am familiar with. The exchange rates for foreign **currency** change daily.
english: money or other items used to facilitate transactions

paragraph: Do you feel any pain in your **stomach**? My **stomach** feels like it's on fire. I do not have any **stomach** problems.
english: digestive organ
arabicDesc: مثال: أتحس بوجع في بطنك؟

other.meaning: belly — see also abdomen, belly

paragraph: I have the **impression** that he knows the secret. Give me your **impression** of this book. What's your **impression** of the United States?
english: overall effect of something
arabicDesc: مثال: يبدوا لي أنه يعلم السر

other.meaning: impersonation

paragraph: The bowl had some thick dark **liquid** in it. Matter can exist as a solid, **liquid**, or gas. Water is **liquid**. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
english: a substance that is flowing, and keeping no shape, such as water
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: مائع

paragraph: I'm looking for ways to improve my self-**awareness**. I hope he learns about respect and self-**awareness**. The patient showed no **awareness** of where she was.
english: the state or level of consciousness where sense data can be confirmed by an observer

paragraph: The last three coaches of the train were **badly** damaged. Only a few of the passengers were **badly** injured. I feel like this is going to end **badly**.
english: in a bad way; also very much
arabicDesc: مثال: عربات القطار الأخيرة كانت قدد تضررت للغاية.

paragraph: The fake **concrete** blocks were installed on the stage. What do you intend to do with the **concrete**? He broke up the **concrete** block with a hammer.
english: real, actual, tangible

other.meaning: A building material created by mixing cement, water, and aggregate such as gravel and sand (noun)

paragraph: She regretted **deeply** when she looked back on her life. I was **deeply** moved by his speech. He is **deeply** in debt now.
english: very much; to a deep level
arabicDesc: مثال: ندمت كثيرا حين تأملت في ما مضى من حياتها.

paragraph: Science **fiction** is like video games for some people. For me, the real world is just a **fiction**. Stills from science **fiction** films hang on the walls.
english: literary type using invented or imaginative writing, instead of real facts, usually written as prose
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: رواية

paragraph: Do you really think money will bring you **happiness**? To love and to be loved is the greatest **happiness**. Health is an important factor of **happiness**.
english: emotion of being happy
arabicDesc: مثال: أتعتقد حقّا أن المال سيجلب لك السعادة?

paragraph: What if something **horrible** happens to me? He was making **horrible** choices. Why is life so **horrible**?
english: causing horror, terrible
arabicDesc: مثال: ماذا لو حدث لي شيء فظيع؟

other.meaning: tremendously bad

paragraph: **Jimmy** was hurt in a traffic accident. Is **Jimmy** writing a letter? **Jimmy** is easy for me to get along with.
english: diminutive of James
arabicDesc: مثال: أصيب جيمي في حادث سير.

paragraph: I am very **pleased** with my new house. I am **pleased** to see you. What are you so **pleased** about?
english: happy, content
arabicDesc: مثال: أنا راضٍ تماما ببيتي الجديد.

paragraph: If we have money problems we can always dip into our **savings**. Generally speaking, **savings** are increasing. I have my life **savings** invested in this store.
english: money that you have kept and not spent
arabicDesc: مثال: اذا كانت لدينا مشاكل مالية ، نستطيع دائماً الاستعانة بمدخراتنا.

paragraph: Please **forgive** me for not having written sooner. I can't **forgive** him for what he did. I do not **forgive** you at all.
english: (''transitive'') to pardon
arabicDesc: مثال: إعذرني لأني لم أكتب أبكر.

paragraph: It's the perfect place for a **romantic** dinner. I like you, but not in a **romantic** way. I didn't know that you could be so **romantic**.
english: concerned with, or conducive to, romance and love
arabicDesc: مثال: يُعدّ المطعم الأفضل لعشاء رومانسي.

other.meaning: A person with romantic character (a character like those of the knights in a mythic romance) (noun)

paragraph: Why did she paint the **bench** red? He's sitting on the **bench**. The rest area has a few **benches**.
english: a long seat with or without a back, found for example in parks and schools
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا دهنت المقعد باللون الأحمر.

paragraph: The office held a **memorial** for him. The event is held the Sunday before **Memorial** Day every year. I have seen an interesting **memorial**.
english: something, such as a monument, by which someone or something is remembered
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: نصب تذكاري

paragraph: Let me take my **jacket** off. I was given a new **jacket**. He had a blue **jacket** on.
english: piece of clothing worn on the upper body outside a shirt or blouse
arabicDesc: مثال: دعني أنزع سترتي.

paragraph: What does it mean to develop a sound **architecture**? Talking about music is like dancing about **architecture**. We walked through the city and enjoyed the beautiful **architecture**.
english: any particular style of building design
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: عمارة

paragraph: Visiting all the **tourist** sights really wore me out. In the **tourist** season, many hotels raise prices. Almost every **tourist** carries a camera with him.
english: someone who travels for pleasure
arabicDesc: مثال: زيارة جميع المعالم السياحية حقاً ترهقني كثيراً .

paragraph: The Moon is the only natural **satellite** of Earth. What signal strength are you receiving from the **satellite**? Choose a suitable **satellite** image as the base map.
english: a moon or other smaller body orbiting a larger one
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: تابع

other.meaning: man-made apparatus designed to be placed in orbit around a celestial body

paragraph: We walked a few minutes and reached the **shore**. The ship stopped a little way off the **shore**. The waves usually break when they reach the **shore**.
english: land adjoining a non-flowing body of water, such as an ocean, lake or pond
arabicDesc: كلمات قريبة: ساحل

paragraph: China has nuclear missiles that the US can't **detect**. The aliens can **detect** all life forms in the area. They won't **detect** anything out of the ordinary.
english: to discover or notice, especially by careful search, examination, or probing

paragraph: **Donate** your money to the poor and you'll have treasure in heaven. You can **donate** your old furniture to families who can't afford it. I want to **donate** money.
english: to give away something of value
arabicDesc: مثال: تبرع باموالك الى الفقراء وسوف تمتلك كنز فى الجنة

paragraph: They have charging **robots** at this gas station. In 2024, there will be a **robot** in every home. A **robot** can work more than a human being.
english: intelligent mechanical being
arabicDesc: مثال: لديهم روبوتات شحن في محطّة الوقود هذه.

paragraph: Why do you learn **Polish**? My mother tongue is **Polish**. I can understand **Polish**, but I can't speak it.
english: of Poland or its language
arabicDesc: مثال: لماذا تتعلم اللغة البولندية؟

other.meaning: The language spoken in Poland (noun)
To shine (verb)

paragraph: **Android** is an operating system designed for mobile phones. The development of applications for **Android** is possible from today. We're developing an **Android** application at the moment.
english: a robot that is designed to look and act like a human being (not necessarily a male one)

other.meaning: A mobile operating system currently developed by Google (noun)

paragraph: Her doctor wants to send her to a **specialist**. Everything goes from bad to worse for the **specialist**. It is best that we speak with a **specialist**.
english: someone who is an expert in, or devoted to, some specific branch of study or research
arabicDesc: مثال: يريد طبيبها أن يرسلها إلى أخصائي.
